_comment: Copy to appsettings.json (gitignored) and fill in the passwords. Ports match docker-compose.yml, which remaps Postgres to 5433 and MySQL to 3308 so the stack cannot collide with a server already installed on the machine. Leave a string empty to skip that dialect's tests; a non-empty string that cannot connect fails them instead. JAUNTY_TEST_SQLSERVER / _POSTGRESQL / _MYSQL / _MARIADB take priority over this file.
